description: For 비대면 pilot visits, adds one 비대면진료 시범사업 관리료 line (91001 주간 / 91002 야간 / 91003 심야 / 91004 공휴) per consultation line, priced from a hardcoded score x yearly unit price, and keeps those lines in sync when the visit time, consultation count or 비대면 flag changes.

inputSchema.fn: 'Pd+Ed' (one fee line for a time), 'xo', 'qh', 'jh', 'Wh' (rebuild on 비대면 toggle), 'Uv (watcher)' (reactive sync; steps are successive state patches).
inputSchema.holidays: Map keyed 'yyyyMMdd' (only presence matters); Sunday is always 공휴.
inputSchema.처방목록: Prescription lines {id, 수가코드, 카테고리숫자코드, 처방명, 금액, 단가, 일투여량, 투약일수}.
inputSchema.수가코드목록: Wh: fee master rows for consultation codes (synthetic names/prices).
inputSchema.설정: Wh: 진료설정 forwarded to the consultation-fee rule (lee).
inputSchema.보험구분: jh: coverage; with 비대면시범사업여부, 한방첩약시범사업, 방문진료대상구분, 방문진료료처방있음.
inputSchema.initial: Uv: {진료내용: {진료Id, 비대면시범사업여부, 기준일시, 처방, 자보1일2차여부?}, 활성, holidays}.

jh 산재 with 비대면 already on

openQuestions: The fee amount is computed client-side from a hardcoded score 28.79 and a per-year unit price table {2025: 102.4, 2026: 104.3}, rounded to 10 won; any other year falls back to 2026 with only a console.error. The server should source this from fee master data — confirm the formula.
Time bands are fixed (주간 09-18, Saturday 09-13; 야간 07-09 and 18(13)-20; 심야 20-07) and ignore the clinic's 주간진찰료산정기준 settings used for face-to-face night surcharges. Intended?
One 관리료 line is added per consultation line (counting codes starting with '10'); with 비대면 the consultation rule returns a single base code, so normally one line. Is more than one ever valid?
When 비대면 is on, consultation codes are reset to the base code with no age/night/holiday digits (lee returns the input unchanged).
If 설정 or the fee master is missing, or the base code is not in the fee master, the old consultation lines (possibly with surcharges) are kept and a 관리료 line is still added.
xo matches only exact 91001-91004; '91000…' telemedicine codes used elsewhere are not treated as 관리료 lines.

Sync runs in a Vue watcher: changes made while inactive or before holidays load are remembered and applied later; switching 진료Id drops pending changes; 자보1일2차여부 visits are skipped. The server needs an explicit recompute trigger instead.
jh hides the 비대면 toggle for 자보/산재/일반 and for 건보/급여 visits with 첩건시범사업 or 방문진료, unless 비대면 is already on.
